name: sovereign-content-pipeline
description: Sovereign weekly content pipeline — Strategy → Copy → Design → QA → Approval

steps.name: Strategy Agent
steps.description: Read project memory, brand data, metric history. Generate weekly plan.

steps.name: Copy + Localization Agent
steps.description: Generate bilingual copy per tactic. Gulf Saudi Arabic tone. RTL enforced.

steps.name: Design Agent
steps.description: fal.ai scene generation. Thmanyah Arabic overlay. Brand colors applied.

steps.name: QA Agent
steps.description: Validate copy tone, check excluded topics, score asset 0-100.

steps.name: Approval Agent
steps.description: Notify Omar via email + Telegram. Assets queued in inbox.

steps.name: Error Handler
steps.description: Send failure details to Omar via Telegram.

schedule.description: Every Monday at 7am — run full pipeline for all active projects
